from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Literal

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The official title of the judgment document")
    cause_category: List[Literal[
        "行政行为 - 行政登记",
        "与公司，证券，保险，票据等有关的民事纠纷",
        "执行案由 - 先予执行",
        "执行案由 - 对下级法院执行异议裁定的复议",
        "行政行为 - 行政裁决",
        "刑事赔偿",
        "执行案由 - 其他案由"
    ]] = Field(description="The case cause-of-action category for this document, based on the provided list")
    supporting_terms: List[str] = Field(description="Keywords or phrases from the document supporting the classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: List[DocumentInfo]
